_about: Shared rule shortcuts. 'remake' notes mark where the Switch 2 remake differs from the N64 game.

has_explosives.rule: BombBag and (bombs_without_bracelet or GoronBracelet or start_with_goron_bracelet)
has_explosives.note: remake: holding a bomb needs the bracelet's lift strength (found by the French randomizer's players). The bombs_without_bracelet setting (on by default) is the game fix in tools/build_mod.py: the bomb's lift grade lowered to the 'no upgrade' grade; confirmed in game on 2026-11-15 (bombs held, thrown and exploding without the bracelet)

can_child_attack: is_child and (Slingshot or Boomerang or DekuSticks or KokiriSword or has_explosives or (DinsFire and can_use_magic))

can_defeat_wolfos.rule: is_adult or (is_child and (KokiriSword or DekuSticks or Slingshot or has_explosives or (DinsFire and can_use_magic)))
can_defeat_wolfos.note: as in the N64 logic (the boomerang only stuns); the slingshot is enough (checked in game, Sacred Forest Meadow gate)

can_stun_deku: is_adult or DekuSticks or KokiriSword or Slingshot or Boomerang or DekuNuts or DekuShield or has_explosives

can_become_adult.note: placeholder until the Temple of Time is mapped (the remake's Door of Time is open; the pedestal needs the Master Sword in the French randomizer)

can_leave_forest.rule: is_adult or open_forest or 'Deku Tree Clear'
can_leave_forest.note: closed forest: a child leaves only after the Deku Tree (Kokiri guard at the bridge; Lost Woods exits too)

can_plant_bean.note: a bean planted as a child grows a platform for adult

can_dive.note: as in the N64 logic; check the depths in the remake
